description.value:
Requirements You have at least one hand free and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You swoop down, use your arms to grab your friend, and fly them off to safety. You Fly or Tail Glide for each action you used to Sky-Save. At any point during this movement, you can seize hold of one willing ally within reach, taking them with you for the duration of your movement. When Sky-Save ends, choose if you are carrying the ally (making the ally @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Grabbed]) or Release the ally (the ally must be willing to be Released).
